seoTitle: How to Get a TradingView Free Trial the Right Way
metaDescription: Learn how to activate a TradingView free trial for Pro, Pro+, or Premium, check eligibility, and cancel before billing if you don't want to continue.
intro: Testing TradingView's premium features before committing financially is possible through its official free trial, but knowing the eligibility rules and cancellation steps can save you from an unwanted charge. This guide covers which plans typically offer a trial, how to activate it correctly, and how to cancel before billing kicks in. It's aimed at traders who want to explore advanced tools risk-free.

steps.heading: Confirm TradingView offers a free trial
steps.body: Check the official pricing page to see which plans, such as Pro, Pro+, or Premium, currently offer a free trial in 2026.

steps.heading: Start the free trial step by step
steps.body: Sign up through TradingView's official site with your account details to activate the trial for your chosen plan.

steps.heading: Understand eligibility and common errors
steps.body: Review any eligibility rules, such as whether you've used a trial before, to avoid errors when trying to activate it.

steps.heading: Cancel the trial safely
steps.body: If you don't want to continue after testing the features, cancel through your account settings before the trial period ends.

steps.heading: Use premium features effectively during the trial
steps.body: Make the most of your trial window by actively testing the advanced tools you're most interested in before deciding whether to subscribe.

faq.question: Do all TradingView plans offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Trial availability can vary by plan and by current promotions, so check the official pricing page to confirm what's currently offered.

faq.question: Will I be charged automatically after the trial ends?
faq.answer: Yes, most trials require a payment method upfront and will bill you automatically unless you cancel before the trial period ends.

faq.question: Can I use a free trial more than once?
faq.answer: Trial eligibility is typically limited to new users or a set period, so reusing a trial multiple times may not be possible.

faq.question: What features are usually included in a TradingView trial?
faq.answer: Trials generally unlock premium features like additional indicators, advanced alerts, and extra chart layouts tied to the specific plan you're testing.
